primitives.name: Cloud-Local Duality Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: If it's not on the cloud, it didn't happen and it WILL be lost.

primitives.name: Continuous Push Protocol
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Continuous, not final Push work-in-progress, not just finished work.

primitives.name: Bus State Monitoring
primitives.verbatim_quote: The lead (Motif) watches the branch and the bus; silence is a signal.

layer2.mapping: Derived from \( \mathcal{C} \) and \( \mathcal{L} \), \( \mathcal{B} \) is a filter kernel of \( \mathcal{C} \).

These operators form a closed-loop system where \( \mathcal{L} \) is a transient state, \( \mathcal{C} \) is the persistent state, and \( \mathcal{B} \) is the observer. The duality enforces causality: \( \mathcal{C} \) must be updated before \( \mathcal{L} \) can be considered valid. The system is thus a causal lattice with time-dependent observables.
